BrightwingGreaterPolymorphPolymorph.name: Greater Polymorph
BrightwingGreaterPolymorphPolymorph.description: Passive: Increase Polymorph's range by 30%. If Brightwing hits an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center within 2 seconds of being Polymorphed, then reduce Polymorph's cooldown by 7 seconds and gain 50 Mana.

BrightwingPhaseShiftHyperShift.name: Hyper Shift
BrightwingPhaseShiftHyperShift.description: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health. Nearby enemy Minion deaths reduce Phase Shift's cooldown by 1 second.

BrightwingPixieCharm.name: Pixie Charm
BrightwingPixieCharm.description: Activate to consume 20 stacks of Bribe to instantly defeat an uncaptured non-Elite Mercenary. Passive: Gain 1 stack of Bribe when a nearby enemy Minion dies, and 5 stacks when hitting an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center. Maximum 80 stacks.

BrightwingDreamShotArcaneFlare.name: Dream Shot
BrightwingDreamShotArcaneFlare.description: Increase Arcane Flare's range by 50%. Hitting a Hero with Arcane Flare's center reduces its cooldown to 2 seconds.

BrightwingUnstableAnomalyPolymorph.name: Unstable Anomaly
BrightwingUnstableAnomalyPolymorph.description: Increase Polymorph's Slow by 15%. Upon expiration, Polymorph deals damage to nearby enemy Heroes equal to 2% of their maximum Health.

BrightwingMagicSpit.name: Magic Spit
BrightwingMagicSpit.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

BrightwingArcaneFlareStickyFlare.name: Sticky Flare
BrightwingArcaneFlareStickyFlare.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Arcane Flare have their Movement Speed Slowed by 20% for 3 seconds. Increase the Slow to 40% if they are hit by the center portion.

BrightwingPhaseShiftPeekaboo.name: Peekaboo!
BrightwingPhaseShiftPeekaboo.description: Phase Shifting to an ally grants both Brightwing and her target a 335 (+4% per level) Shield for 4 seconds and reveals a large area around them for 5 seconds.

BrightwingCriticalMistCalmingMist.name: Critical Mist
BrightwingCriticalMistCalmingMist.description: Soothing Mist heals allied Heroes for 165 (+4% per level). Increase this healing by 140% if Soothing Mist removed a disabling effect from that ally.

FaerieDragonHeroicAbilityBlinkHeal.name: Blink Heal
FaerieDragonHeroicAbilityBlinkHeal.description: Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level). Stores up to 2 charges.

FaerieDragonHeroicAbilityEmeraldWind.name: Emerald Wind
FaerieDragonHeroicAbilityEmeraldWind.description: After 0.5 seconds, create an expanding nova of wind, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and pushing enemies away.

BrightwingPixieBoostPixieDust.name: Pixie Boost
BrightwingPixieBoostPixieDust.description: Pixie Dust gives 50% bonus Movement Speed, decaying to 20% over 3 seconds.

BrightwingPixieDustSafetyDust.name: Safety Dust
BrightwingPixieDustSafetyDust.description: Increase Pixie Dust's duration by 1 second. Soothing Mist and Blink Heal heal allies with an active Pixie Dust for 75% more.

BrightwingPixieDustPixiePower.name: Pixie Power
BrightwingPixieDustPixiePower.description: Reduce the cooldown of Pixie Dust by 3 seconds and increase the Spell Armor granted by 25.

BrightwingArcaneFlareHush!.name: Hush!
BrightwingArcaneFlareHush!.description: Enemy Heroes hit by the center of Arcane Flare are Silenced for 1 second and deal 25% less damage for 3 seconds.

FaerieDragonMasteryCritterize.name: Critterize
FaerieDragonMasteryCritterize.description: While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.

BrightwingPhaseOut.name: Phase Out
BrightwingPhaseOut.description: Activate to place Brightwing in Stasis for 0.75 seconds.

BrightwingInvisibleFriends.name: Invisible Friends
BrightwingInvisibleFriends.description: Blink Heal grants Stealth to Brightwing and her Heroic targets for 9 seconds, and they are Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds. While Stealthed by Invisible Friends, Heroes heal for 25 (+4% per level) health per second. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Steal

BrightwingIntensiveWinds.name: Intensive Winds
BrightwingIntensiveWinds.description: Permanently reduce Emerald Wind's cooldown to 5 seconds.

BrightwingSpeedyDragon.name: Speedy Dragon
BrightwingSpeedyDragon.description: Permanently gain 20% Movement Speed. Reduce Phase Shift's cast time by 1 second.

BrightwingFaerieProtector.name: Faerie Protector
BrightwingFaerieProtector.description: Activate to apply Pixie Dust to all nearby Heroes. Passive: Pixie Dust always bounces back and applies to Brightwing.
